confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on 2026 aggregator and menu-style snippets from several sources that disagree, so they are bounded estimates. Cocktail and wine anchors are less certain: wine by the glass was not found directly, so wine_glass uses a beer-relationship estimate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. FX is weaker than the other fields: the only RBA-domain observation retrieved is from March 2026, and the latest November 2026 RBA observation could not be retrieved, so as_of_date and source_rate may be stale and should be verified against the RBA F11.1 daily table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Mexican tourist city. Food and drink anchors are based on cost-of-living aggregator figures and 2026 Mérida bar and menu snippets, with national Mexican beverage prices used as a cross-check. Wine by the glass is estimated from the local beer relationship, since no per-glass price was found. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate from Mérida's general lodging tier.
